frozen_before: S_OP7 and S_OP8 exist. No specialist has been trained or evaluated.
authorized_by: PI selection of S_OP7 + S_OP8 after PATH_B fired

triggered_by.evidence_label: preregistered DISCOVERY, family-wise error NOT controlled

purpose: Test whether the discovered OP7/OP8 matchup structure can be deliberately amplified by explicit single-opponent training, and whether the resulting repertoire has routing value over the best single policy.

target_selection_is_data_driven_and_disc.why_changed: OP12 is at ceiling (column mean .9958; six of eight policies score 1.000), so it has no headroom to show a crossover. OP7 is the hardest column (.6417) and OP8 carries the only diversity gradient that survived both D3 seeds (D1 .878 > D3 .783 > D7 .767).
target_selection_is_data_driven_and_disc.honesty_note: Because targets were chosen after seeing the matrix, this pilot is CONFIRMATORY for the OP7/OP8 pair only. It cannot also serve as independent discovery of that pair.

training.inherits: run_g0_v5_long (reward, architecture, health gates) via run_vgc_specialist.py, same reuse pattern as run_vgc_diversity.py
training.namespace_note: S_OP7/S_OP8 are SPECIALISTS, a different experiment from the D1/D3/D7 diversity conditions. They must never be reported as a diversity rung.

evaluation.why_60_not_30: the oracle gate requires a split-half estimate; 60 gives 30 per half, matching the precision of the main matrix
evaluation.paired_seeds: every policy sees the same episode seed block per opponent, as in run_g0_v2_evaluation

gates.reused_from: the K=2 LRO specialist gate structure (gate1/gate2/delta_pool), so this pilot is directly comparable to that prior negative result

delta_pool_definition.V_selective: mean over opponents of the win rate of the policy selected for that opponent
delta_pool_definition.V_fixed: max over policies of that policy's mean win rate across opponents

SPLIT_HALF_ORACLE.why: a naive oracle takes max over policies on the SAME episodes used to score it, which is positively biased by construction and cannot return a negative gap
SPLIT_HALF_ORACLE.rule: episodes per cell are split into half A and half B by seed parity. The per-opponent argmax policy is SELECTED on half A and SCORED on half B. V_fixed is likewise scored on half B.
SPLIT_HALF_ORACLE.consequence: delta_pool CAN come out negative or zero under this estimator. That is the point.
SPLIT_HALF_ORACLE.uncertainty: paired bootstrap over half-B episodes, 10000 resamples, 95% LCB

delta_pool_definition.practical_floor_rationale: delta_pool >= 0.05 win-rate points is required in addition to LCB95 > 0. Per-cell SE at n=30 is ~0.085, and any realizable selector recovers only a fraction of the oracle gap, so an oracle advantage below 0.05 cannot support a usable router. This floor is a judgment call and is fixed here, before any specialist exists, precisely so it cannot be tuned later.

prior_result_this_pilot_must_be_read_aga.outcome: FAILED at the 1M gate. gate1 PASS, gate2 FAIL, delta_pool = 0.0000 exactly -- one policy was argmax in BOTH contexts, so selective value equalled fixed value. 0/9 seed pairings showed both crossover directions.
prior_result_this_pilot_must_be_read_aga.mechanism: a payoff crossover among SCRIPTED probes did not survive PPO training; the intended specialist became the better generalist instead.
prior_result_this_pilot_must_be_read_aga.what_is_different_now: the crossover this time was observed between TRAINED PPO policies on a held-out board, not between scripted probes. That is a stronger starting point but not a guarantee.
prior_result_this_pilot_must_be_read_aga.standing_rule_from_that_result: do not re-run the gate hoping for a different verdict, and do not select an earlier checkpoint post hoc to claim a pass. Only the 1M checkpoint is the formal gate.

stopping_rule.if_all_three_gates_pass: explicit repertoire has value. Proceed to the LEGAL SELECTOR phase (can observable state/history pick the right policy?). Latent compression remains gated behind a working selector.
stopping_rule.if_gate3_fails: STOP the escalation. There is no useful routing problem even with perfect hindsight. Report the diversity-scaling result and the PATH_B discovery as a discovery that did not convert.
stopping_rule.if_gate1_or_gate2_fails: the crossover did not survive deliberate training -- the same failure mode as K=2. STOP and report.
prohibited: widening the opponent board after seeing results to find a pair that passes
lowering the 0.05 floor or dropping the split-half estimator
adding seeds to rescue a failed gate (a failed gate is a result, not a power problem)
reporting a naive same-episode oracle gap as delta_pool

does_not_change: the frozen D1/D3/D7 sets and their completed results
